label: TP
reason: User-controlled cookie value flows through URL decoding and Base64 round-trip directly into the filename argument of File constructor, which is then used in a directory listing operation via ESAPI encoder. The Base64 operations preserve all characters including script tags, allowing attackers to inject arbitrary content into the rendered HTML output.

evidence.note: Cookie value decoded and re-encoded via Base64, then passed to File constructor and printed to response
